claims.quote: (5) The following statement in boldface type:  “You may seek the advice of an attorney in any matter connected with the complaint or this summons. Such attorney should be consulted promptly so that your pleading may be filed or entered within the time required by this summons.”
claims.note: The draft omits this required statement, which is separate from the opening legend.

flags.text: The checklist omits the boldface attorney-consultation statement required by (a)(5).

The cited range ends at (a)(4); the opening legend is supported by (a)(6). The draft gives its opening words but not the required warning about a decision without a hearing or the direction to read below.
Under (b), a county ordinance may require the legend in an additional language. This can matter within the stated ordinary-civil scope.

result.summary: The listed features are supported. The checklist is incomplete, most notably because it omits a separate mandatory boldface statement.
